Jinx enemies add a fixed batch of permanent Jinx cards when the fight starts, never more during combat.
Select 1 to 5 cards and play the best po: Select 1 to 5 cards and play the best poker hand among them for 2 energy. Bigger hands hit harder; pairs give shield and flushes heal. Only the cards you play are discarded.

Deal (1 energy) draws from your deck; th: Deal (1 energy) draws from your deck; the enemy dealer has its own deck and draws to 17. Win: damage equal to your total (natural blackjack: 30) plus chips to spend on perks in the shop. Lose or bust: the enemy hits you. A push refunds the energy.
All five Jinx types can appear from floo: All five Jinx types can appear from floor 1. Each counts as 0 but adds a penalty: Debt reduces winning chips by 2; Weakness reduces winning damage by 5 (both per copy, before multipliers, minimum 0); Backlash deals 3 shield-blockable damage on draw; House Edge makes ties lose (does not stack); Bad Luck lowers your bust limit by 2 per copy, with Aces adapting to the lower limit. Jinxes stay in your deck until removed through rewards or the shop.

After each fight, pick one of three rewa: After each fight, pick one of three rewards: a deck edit, a card upgrade or a Joker (up to 3, each a passive rule change). After each boss, you may take a Curse (a powerful boon with a permanent cost), then spend chips at the shop on potions, cards, Jokers and extra Joker slots.
